commitSubject: Only mask opacity that draws at alpha 255
change: Mask gate requires the DRAWN alpha byte to be 255 (OverlayAlpha::IsFullyOpaque) instead of opacity >= 0.999f. Which opacities may mask changed; the drawn byte did not.
freshness: headers touched before build; 934 assertions / 88 cases green; separate [mask] run confirmed the new cases compiled (618 assertions, 22 cases)

pdbLink.method: SECONDARY sanity check only - GUID is per-project and a PDB holds multiple info streams, so (GUID,age) is not a unique build identity; byte identity above is the primary check

mutationProof: restoring the old >= 0.999f comparison fails the suite (tests/test_overlay_alpha.cpp:28); rounding instead of truncating also fails (:20)
whatThisDoesNotProve: Not cross-machine reproducible: no scratch-worktree rebuild of this commit was run, so this attests that ONE machine built these bytes from this revision, not that any machine would.
whyThisExists: A hash records the bytes shipped, not that they came from the intended source.
symbolsContainer: PDB. These are C++ symbol names and live in the .pdb, NOT the .dll - probing the DLL returns 0 for all of them and that 0 is not evidence the record is false. Counts must match EXACTLY, not >=.
backupHolds: PRE-deployment files, captured before the copy. backup/HelmetOverlaysNG.dll is deliberately NOT equal to dllSHA256 and appears in no hash field; a mismatch there means the backup worked, not that the install was tampered with.
treeBuildFieldsProvenance: NOT RECORDED at deploy time. The deployed artefact was verified byte-identical to the tree build then, but that tree-build hash was not written down separately, and the tree has since moved to 3cef032. Null means "not captured", NOT "failed" - reconstructing it now would be a fabricated field. The byte identity claim stands; the independent hash does not exist.
deploymentArtifactPreservation: No deployed/ copy in this directory. Survives only because the NEXT record's backup/ holds these bytes.
normalisedSource: Computed from the preserved DEPLOYED bytes, not from the backup in this directory.
mutationProofProvenance: Recorded at deploy time as: restoring the old >= 0.999f comparison fails the suite (tests/test_overlay_alpha.cpp:28); rounding instead of truncating also fails (:20) Provenance added during a later audit; the proof text itself is unchanged.
treeBuildDLLSHA256Provenance: NOT RECORDED at deploy time: this record predates the practice of capturing the tree-build hash before deploying. Null means not captured, NOT a failed comparison.
treeBuildPDBSHA256Provenance: NOT RECORDED at deploy time, and never captured by any record in this chain: the tree-build PDB hash was asked for by the schema but the deploy script never wrote it from this deploy onward. Null means the field was never observed, not that a comparison failed.

postHocAnnotations.note: Added 2026-10-31T22:53:05+00:00 by HONG after the record was written, when a checker finally read the records. No measurement was invented: this string explains an existing null, and the null and every hash in the record are unchanged.
